caption: The drawing depicts a wooden armchair with a padded seat and backrest, both of which are upholstered in a reddish-pink fabric. The frame of the chair, including its legs, armrests, and the outline of the backrest, is rendered in a brownish wood tone. The backrest features a scalloped, gently arched top, and the armrests are curved with a scroll detail at the front. The front legs of the chair are cabriole-shaped, with a gentle outward curve and a slight scroll at the foot, while the back legs are straight. In the top left corner of the drawing, there is a separate black-and-white line illustration of an ornate, vertically-oriented decorative furniture leg detail. The background is off-white with no additional objects or scenery, and the composition places the chair centrally, with the smaller drawing above and to the left of the main subject.
title: Armchair
